verdict.rationale: Agent-readable documentation is a fair axis for an MCP registry and connection platform, but the probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no docs.md (HTTP 404), and the shutdown notice says the docs tree has been removed. Context7 is a third-party server listed in the registry, not Smithery's own agent-oriented docs, and the CLI is a tool surface rather than documentation, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
